# Central Air Services, LLC

> AC service & installation based in San Antonio, Texas. Owner Gerald Lund repairs, cleans and installs AC and heating systems across San Antonio and out to Seguin, and reviewers say he shows up fast, explains everything and never pushes a big repair.

- Phone: (210) 668-5899
- Based in: San Antonio, TX
- Service area: San Antonio, Seguin, China Grove, Elmendorf, St. Hedwig, Converse
- Google rating: 5.0 from 16 reviews
- Request a quote: https://vinaynay9.github.io/smb_fde/hs/central-air-services/quote.html

## Services
- AC repair & diagnostics: A straight diagnosis first, then the repair, often finished on the same visit.
- Annual tune-ups & coil cleaning: The outdoor coil gets opened up and rinsed clean, and the whole system gets checked over.
- New AC & heating systems: Replacement condensers, air handlers and heating equipment, installed and explained.
- Heating repair & maintenance: Furnaces and heating systems repaired and checked before the first cold front.
- Ducts & vents: Duct and vent repair, new runs and cleaning, in the attic or under the house.
- Wall units & commercial: Window and wall units deep-cleaned, plus service for businesses and multi-unit properties.

## About
Central Air Services, LLC is owned by Gerald Lund, who has 33 years in the business and still does the work himself. The company is based on Goliad Road on San Antonio's southeast side and is licensed as a Texas air conditioning and refrigeration contractor. Gerald and Blanca handle tune-ups, repairs and installs for houses, condos, townhouses and businesses around San Antonio and out to Seguin. Customers book their AC tune-up with him year after year, and reviews keep landing on the same point: an unbiased diagnosis and no push for work you don't need.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Can you come out the same day in San Antonio?
  A: Often, yes. Reviewers mention same-day repairs on hot days and a fast response on a Sunday afternoon. Call and Gerald will tell you when he can be there.
- Q: Do you come out to Seguin and the southeast side?
  A: Yes. Central Air Services is on Goliad Road and works across San Antonio and surrounding areas, including Seguin.
- Q: Will you tell me if I don't need a big repair?
  A: Yes. Customers say Gerald gives a correct, unbiased diagnosis with no pressure and no upselling.
- Q: Do you clean and repair window and wall units?
  A: Yes. Window and wall units get a full cleaning or repair, and one customer said it was like having a whole new unit.
- Q: Do you work on businesses?
  A: Yes. Central Air Services handles residential and commercial HVAC, and local businesses call back for repeat service.
- Q: How can I pay?
  A: Apple Pay, cash, Cash App and Zelle are accepted.
